lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName},

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: someone sent flowers to my dressing room.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Was it you?
?? No.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Really? That's strange...

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: The staff said the person who sent the flowers

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: looked a lot like you.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: But none of my friends look like you at all.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I have to admit, I'm a little disappointed.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I was kind of hoping it would be you.
Sorry, maybe next time.
I'll send you a different present instead.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I know you're busy.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I realize my performance isn't the most important thing,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: and that it'd be unreasonable to be upset.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I know it's a busy time for you,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: so I don't want to add any more pressure.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: But since it came up, I'll let you know in advance

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: that my next performance will be the opera Lake's Sword.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Same location as before: the Opera House on Royal Road.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: The first performance will be on the 5th of next month.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: If you can come in-person to see the show,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: will you send me flowers?
Of course.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Now I have something to look forward to.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I've got to go attend an after-party.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Let's talk again soon.
Have fun.
